verses.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.sm: Arona ma ona atalii i le faiva o faitaulaga d O lenei foi le mea e te faia e faapaiaina ai i latou, ina ia latou auauna mai ia te au i le faiva o le ositaulaga; e te ave le povi poa taanoa e tasi, ma mamoe poa e lua e sao ona lelei;

verses.en: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.sm: ma le areto e le faafefeteina, ma potoi areto e le faafefeteina, e palua ma le uu, ma areto manifinifi e le faafefeteina, ua nini i le uu; o le falaoa o le saito e te fai ai ia mea:

verses.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.sm: E te tuuina foi ia mea i le ato e tasi, ma e au maiai ma le ato, atoa ma le povi poa taanoa, ma mamoe poa e lua.

verses.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.sm: O Arona foi ma ona atalii, e te faalatalataina mai i latou i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, ma ia e faataele ia i latou i le vai.

verses.en: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
verses.sm: E te ave foi ofu, ma faaofuina ai Arona i le ofu tino, ma le ofu talaloa o le efota, ma le efota, ma le ufifatafata, ma e fusi ia te ia i le fusi faalanu eseese o le efota.

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.sm: E te faapulou foi ia te ia i le pulou ie, ma e fusi le pale paia i le pulou ie;

verses.en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.sm: ona e ave lea le uu e faauu ai, ma liligi i luga o lona ulu, ma ia e faauuina ai o ia.

verses.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.sm: E te faalatalata mai foi ona atalii, ma faaofuina i latou i ofu tino.

verses.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be their's for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.sm: E te fusi ia te i latou i fusi, o Arona atoa ma ona atalii, ma faamau o latou pulou, e fai foi mo latou le faiva o ositaulaga, o lc tulafono « faavavau; e te tofia foi Arona ma ona atalii.

verses.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.sm: E te taʻita‘iina mai foi le povi poa taanoa i luma o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga; e faaee foi e Arona ma ona atalii o latou lima i luga o le ulu o le povi poa taanoa.

verses.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: Ona e fasi lea o le povi poa taanoa i luma o le ALII i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.sm: Ona e ave lea nisi toto o le povi poa taanoa, ma tuuina i luga o nifo o le fata faitaulaga i lou tamatamai lima; a o le toto uma e te sasaaina lea i lalo o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
verses.sm: E te ave foi le ga‘o alo uma lava, atoa ma le gaʻo punipu o i luga o le finagalo, ma ona fatuga'o e lua, ma ga'o o i ai, ma ia e susunu ai i luga o le fata faitaulaga;

verses.en: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
verses.sm: a o le aano o le povi poa taanoa, ma lona pau, ma lona otaota, ia e susunuina lava i le afi i tua o le toagalauapi; o le taulaga lea mo le agasala.

verses.en: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.sm: Ona e ave lea o le tasi mamoe poa; e faaee foi e Arona ma ona atalii o latou lima i luga o le ulu o le mamoe poa.

verses.en: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
verses.sm: E te fasi foi le mamoe poa, ma ave lona toto, ma sausau ia soo ai i le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
verses.sm: E te pena foi le mamoe poa i ona tufaaga, ma ia e mulumulu ona totoga ma ona alaga, ona tuuina ane lea i ona tufaaga, ma lona ulu.

verses.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ia e susunu foi le mamoe poa atoa uma i le fata faitaulaga; o le taulaga mu lea i le ALII, o le mea manogi lelei, o le taulaga e fai i le afi i le ALII.

verses.en: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.sm: E te ave foi lona lua o mamoe poa; e faaee foi e Arona ma ona atalii o latou lima i luga o le ulu o le mamoe poa.

verses.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.sm: E te fasi le mamoe poa, ma ia ave sina ona toto, ma tuu i le tumutumu o le taliga taumatau o Arona, ma le tumutumu o taliga taumatau o ona atalii, o lima matua foi o latou lima taumatau, ma vae matua O latou vae taumatau, ma ia sausau ia soo le fata faitaulaga i le toto.

verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.sm: E te ave foi nisi toto o i luga o le fata faitaulaga, ma nisi uu e faauu ai, ma ia e sausau ai i luga o Arona ma ona ofu, atoa ma ona atalii ma ofu o ona atalii faatasi ma ia; ona faapaiaina lea o ia, ma ona ofu, ma ona atalii, atoa ma ofu o ona atalii faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
verses.sm: Ia e ave foi tufaaga o le mamoe poa, O le ga‘o, ma le iu, ma le ga'o alo, ma le ga'o punipu i luga o le finagalo, ma ona fatuga'o e lua, ma ga'o o i ai, ma le alaga taumatau; aua o le mamoe poa ia o le tofiga;

verses.en: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
verses.sm: ma le areto e tasi, ma le potoi areto e tasi e fai i le uu, ma le areto manifinifi e tasi mai le ato o le areto e le faafefeteina o i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.sm: E te faaee foi ia mea uma i alofilima o Arona ma alofilima o ona atalii; ma ia e luluina, o le taulaga lulu lea i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.sm: E te talia foi ia mea ai o latou lima, ma e susunuina i le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, e fai ma mea manogi lelei i luma o le ALII; o le taulaga lea e fai i le afi i le ALrr.

verses.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
verses.sm: Ia e ave foi le fatafata o le mamoe poa i mea e tofia a“ Arona, ma e luluina, o le taulaga lulu lea i luma o le ALII} e fai foi lea ma ou tufaaga.

verses.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
verses.sm: E te faapaia foi le fatafata o le taulaga lulu, ma le alaga o le taulaga sii, o loo luluina ma siitia, O tufaaga ia o le mamoe poa i mea e tofia a“ Arona atoa ma ona atalii;

verses.en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.sm: e fai ia mo Arona ma ona atalii, mai le fanauga a Isaraelu o le tulafono e faavavau; aua O le taulaga sii lea; e fai foi lea ma taulaga sii, mai le fanauga a Isaraelu ai o latou taulaga faafetai, o la latou taulaga sii lea i le ALII.

verses.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.sm: O ofu sa foi o Arona, e fai mona atalii pe a mavae atu o ia, ina ia faauuina ai i latou, ma tofia 5 ai i latou.

verses.en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
verses.sm: O sona atalii e sui a4 o ia i le faiva o ositaulaga, e ofu ai o ia e fitu ona aso, pe a alu ia i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga e auauna ai i le mea paia.

verses.en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.sm: E te ave foi le mamoe poa o le tofiga, ma tunu lona tino i le mea paia.

verses.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: E aai foi e Arona ma ona atalii le tino o le mamoe poa, ma le areto ua i le ato, i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.sm: Latou te aai foi ia mea ua fai aʻi le togiola, e tofia ai ma faapaiaina ai i latou; a e aua le “ai ai se tagata ese, aua e paia lava ia mea.

verses.en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.sm: Pe afai foi e toe sina aano i taulaga o le tofiga, po o le areto, e oo i le taeao, ona e susunu ai lea o le mea e toei le afi; e le “aina, aua e paia lava lea mea.

verses.en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.sm: Ia e fai faapea lava ia Arona ma ona atalii, e pei o mea uma lava na ou fai atu ai ia te oe; o aso e fitu ia e fai ai le tofia oi latou.

verses.en: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.sm: Ia e saunia foi le povi poa taanoa i lea aso ma lea aso, e fai ma taulaga ona o le agasala e togiola a“; ia e faamama foi le fata faitaulaga, pe a e faia le togiola i ona luga, e te faauu ai ia faapaiaina a‘i.

verses.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.sm: E fitu aso e te fai ai le togiola i le fata faitaulaga, ma faapaiaina ai, e fai ai ma fata faitaulaga e sili ona paia; o mea uma foi e papai ane i le fata faitaulaga e paia lava ia.

verses.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.sm: O lenei foi le mea e te faia i luga o le fata faitaulaga, e tailua tamai mamoe e tasi lo la tausaga i lea aso ma lea aso, e le aunoa.

verses.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
verses.sm: O le tasi tamai mamoe e te saunia i le taeao, o le tasi foi tamai ma moe e te saunia i le afiafi.

verses.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.sm: O le tamai mamoe e tasi ma le omera e tasi o falaoa lelei, e palua ma lona vaega e fa o le sinu o uu ua ia; o lona vaega e fa foi o le sinu o uaina mo le taulaga i mea e inu.

verses.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.sm: O le tasi foi tamai mamoe e te saunia i le afiafi, e tusa ma le taulaga i mea e ʻai i le taeao, e tusa foi ma le taulaga i mea e inu e te faia; o le mea manogi lelei lea, o le taulaga e fai i le afi i le ALI.

verses.en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.sm: E faia lenei ma taulaga mu e le aunoa i o outou tupulaga amuli i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i luma o le ALII, o le mea tatou te fetaiai ai ma outou, ina ia ou tautala atu ia te oe i lea mea.

verses.en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.sm: Tatou te fetaiai ai ma le fanauga a Isaraelu i lea mea; e faapaiaina ai foi i loʻu mamalu.

verses.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.sm: Ou te faapaiaina foi le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga ma le fata faitaulaga; o Arona foi ma ona atalii ou te faapaiaina i latou e fai le faiva o ositaulaga ia te au.

verses.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.sm: Ou te nofo faatasi ma le fanauga a Isaraelu; e fai atu mo latou Atua;

verses.en: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
verses.sm: latou te iloa foi, o aʻu o le ALII o lo latou Atua, o le na aumaia i latou nai le nuu o Aikupito, ina ia ou nofo ma i latou; o aʻu o le ALII lo latou Atua.
